purpose: Distinguish evidence about an exact repository candidate from evidence about its composition with a target base.

preconditions: base_commit is an ancestor of candidate_commit
CANDIDATE.meaning: The check executed the exact, reconciled candidate commit. It says nothing by itself about the synthetic merge or later settlement commit.

INTEGRATION.meaning: The check executed a merge composition whose parents are exactly the declared base and candidate. It does not transfer its result onto the candidate commit.

invariants: job names are not evidence of checkout identity
the runner derives observed commit and tree from Git
candidate evidence refuses when HEAD differs from candidate_commit
candidate evidence refuses when the current target base is not already contained by the candidate
candidate evidence refuses merge commits in the base..candidate construction range; reconcile by rebase before qualification
integration evidence refuses unless the integration commit has exactly base_commit then candidate_commit as parents
integration evidence may describe a stale or nonlinear candidate but cannot make that candidate qualification evidence
CI(C) and CI(B,C) are separate evidence and neither substitutes for the other
equal candidate and integration trees do not collapse their distinct commit subjects
a changed candidate commit or tree requires a new candidate evidence set
